pivot_and_uv: Each module uses upstream center and U=0 upstream to U=1 downstream. Local +Y is downwind. V crosses ribbon width. Root and child basis transforms are identity.

inputs.direction: Shared FX-007 normalized horizontal world downwind. Blender (dx,dy,0), RealityKit (dx,0,-dy). For zero direction set strength=0. Yaw is atan2(-dx,dy) about Blender +Z.
inputs.strength: Normalized 0–1 signal shared by FX-002 bands and ENV-012 tree rigs. Strength drives vegetation angle and visual opacity.
inputs.clockSeconds: Common elapsed time. Mesh downstream drift = speed times elapsed phase, aligned to direction. Fade at field ends before reusing.
inputs.motionScale: 0–1; zero freezes advection and neutralizes the tree bend, hides leaves, and retains softly fading low-opacity fixed bands.
inputs.windSpeedBUPerSecond: Nonnegative magnitude, multiply the game-unit speed by 0.036. Default offline sample 1.95 BU/s.
inputs.phaseRad: Optional per-tree stable phase (see FX-007 shared joint basis). Crown lags Stem by .43 rad.
inputs.treeEnvelope: Start wind indicator before all wind ribbons. Bend Stem/Crown about inverse-rest (up cross downwind), preserve Root. Offline max 8/18 degrees before normalized strength.
inputs.warnEnvelope: Drive low alpha on WarnBand and CrownSweep. CrownSweep is a short independent mask placed on exposed treetop edges.
inputs.gustEnvelope: Drive GustBand plus optional Leaf instances. Leaves can tumble locally and fade. Transform all from one wind field.
inputs.rescueAnchorWorld: Host supplies reachable anchor. Leave enough world and projected screen room to keep the beacon and separated goose visible.
inputs.zoneEvent: Game owns all activation, movement, loss/rejoin, and timing. No collisions, event geometry or rescue logic in the export.
